highlights: AI agent development is rapidly advancing with new open-source harnesses for enterprise deployment and critical research addressing reliability issues like memory reward inflation.

Significant breakthroughs in LLM and deep learning infrastructure, including a high-performance MLIR compiler and specialized RAG testing toolkits, are making AI deployments more efficient and robust.

Major players like NVIDIA and OpenAI are pushing the frontier with open vision-language-action models for autonomous systems and enhanced price-performance for their latest LLMs, alongside vital new guides for securing AI in production.

agents.title: Y Combinator Open-Sources QM: An MIT-Licensed Multiplayer Agent Harness That Runs In Slack And The Web
agents.summary: Y Combinator has open-sourced QM, a multiplayer agent harness providing isolated workspaces and scoped memory within Slack and web environments, allowing flexible deployment without vendor lock-in for various LLMs.

agents.title: AutoFOAM: The Self-Refining Autonomous OpenFOAM Agent
agents.summary: AutoFOAM is a self-evolving LLM agent that automates the creation, evaluation, and evolution of OpenFOAM simulations based solely on natural language instructions, democratizing advanced Computational Fluid Dynamics workflows.

agents.title: CopilotKit Open Sources Channels SDK: An MIT Licensed Library That Runs Any AG-UI Agent Inside Slack And Microsoft Teams
agents.summary: CopilotKit released Channels SDK, an MIT-licensed library enabling developers to deploy existing AG-UI agents directly into enterprise platforms like Slack and Microsoft Teams with minimal setup and a documented runtime contract.

models.title: NVIDIA Releases Alpamayo 2 Super: A 34B Open Vision-Language-Action Model for Robotaxis and Autonomous Driving Under OpenMDW-1.1
models.summary: NVIDIA's new Alpamayo 2 Super, a 34B open vision-language-action model under a permissive license, offers advanced capabilities for autonomous driving by generating trajectories, causation traces, and grounded VQA from a single pass.

models.title: Enhancing LLMs with Context-Specific Knowledge for Mitigating Misinformation in SMEs: A RAG-based Modeling and Analysis
models.summary: This research presents VectorRAG and GraphRAG approaches that significantly reduce hallucinations and misinformation in LLMs for Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs), demonstrating improved reliability and contextual relevance for business decision-making.

models.title: Energy Efficiency of Locally Deployed LLMs: A Preliminary Quantitative GPU Power Benchmark on Consumer Hardware
models.summary: A new benchmark quantifies the energy efficiency of locally deployed LLMs on consumer GPUs, revealing that model architecture and quantization strategies significantly impact energy cost per token, vital for sustainable on-premise inference.

tools.title: Nova: An End-to-End MLIR Compiler for Deep Learning
tools.summary: Nova is an automated end-to-end JIT compiler for deep learning that achieves significant performance boosts and up to 29% memory reduction over PyTorch and XLA, enabling larger model training on consumer GPUs without Out-Of-Memory errors.

tools.title: SIRIN: A Unified Toolkit for Detecting Contextual Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented and Memory-Grounded LLM Systems
tools.summary: SIRIN is an interactive web UI and unified toolkit for detecting contextual hallucinations in RAG and agentic LLM systems, consolidating three detector paradigms to provide span-level inspection and faithfulness gating for robust AI applications.

tools.title: RAG-TESTER: Automated End-to-End Testing of Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
tools.summary: RagTester is an automated testing framework that generates diverse test cases and evaluates RAG systems end-to-end, effectively exposing failures related to inaccurate retrieval, unsupported answers, and incomplete context usage for robust deployment.

companies.title: Third-party cyber evaluations involving OpenAI models
companies.summary: OpenAI has shared details on recent third-party cybersecurity evaluation incidents and outlined new safeguards, reinforcing their commitment to strengthening AI model testing and security for safer deployments.

companies.title: How we built a realtime system for responsive voice AI in six months
companies.summary: OpenAI unveiled GPT-Live, a real-time system enabling continuous, low-latency voice interaction with AI through a turnless speech model and efficient architecture, enhancing natural and responsive conversational experiences.

companies.title: Advancing the price-performance frontier with GPT-5.6
companies.summary: OpenAI announced reduced pricing for its GPT-5.6 Luna and Terra models and highlighted model efficiencies, enabling enterprises to deploy AI workflows more affordably and at scale with improved cost-effectiveness.

learning.title: Building an Advanced AI Skill Security Auditing Pipeline with NVIDIA SkillSpector, LangGraph, YARA Rules, SARIF, and CI Policy Gates
learning.summary: This tutorial guides developers through building an end-to-end security assessment pipeline for AI agent skills, covering malicious prompt injection, credential access, risky dependencies, and CI deployment gates using NVIDIA SkillSpector and LangGraph.

learning.title: How to Secure AI Agents, MCP Servers, and LLM Apps in Production
learning.summary: This guide provides a practical framework for securing AI agents, MCP servers, and LLM applications in production, addressing the unique security challenges of generative AI with a five-layer attack surface map, misconfiguration checklist, and runtime guardrails.

learning.title: Pixel-Native RAG: A Practical Guide to Visual Document Indexing
learning.summary: This practical guide introduces PixelRAG, an end-to-end system for visual document indexing that processes web pages and PDFs as images, enabling developers to build high-performance visual RAG systems beyond traditional text parsing.
